description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 420/25 of 26.09.1986 in relation to the Eastern University of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument that amends the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under Section 27(1) of the Act, modifying the structure of the Eastern University, Sri Lanka by adding a new Faculty of Technology and its departments. This falls under legal framework modifications and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
